_comment: Single source for executor dispatch and per-role model injection. Role definitions and cross-model policy are in workflows/coding.md. opencode model format is provider/model (e.g. opencode/minimax-m3-free). claude model accepts alias (e.g. haiku-4.5) or full model ID.

_roles_reference.CODER: Writes implementation code following a plan
_roles_reference.TESTER: Writes tests from plan spec + public API only — must differ from CODER
_roles_reference.REVIEWER: Reviews code for bugs, security, style — must differ from CODER; tier >= CODER
_roles_reference.VERIFIER: Goal-backward plan verification — must differ from CODER
_roles_reference.ARCHITECT: Adversarial plan review — trade-offs, over-engineering, bugs
_roles_reference.ANALYST: Business logic review — ROI, domain correctness, user impact
_roles_reference.RESEARCHER: Investigate unknowns, synthesize findings, cross-review sources
_roles_reference.NOTEWRITER: Obsidian writes — diary, inbox, knowledge extraction
_roles_reference.LOCAL: Privacy-sensitive or local-language tasks — runs on-device
